risk_note: RV2 (union, read-only). D10-1401 dashboard card union_auth_expiring: union exports countUnionAuthPending(db, appId) = number of the app's union_accounts with auth_status IN (expiring, expired). auth_status is the stored column the daily check writes from union.auth_alert_days (expiring) and on expiry / an authorization-failure probe or call (expired); timeouts and rate limits do not change it (BR-ID-24 ①④), so 01 F-ADM-26 'about to expire or probe-invalid' is exactly this set and last_probe_ok is not read. The judgement lives once in union/domain/auth-pending.ts (UNION_AUTH_PENDING_STATUSES, isUnionAuthPending); adminListUnionAccounts is unpaged and unfiltered, its behaviour and contract unchanged (admin-accounts.ts only documents that its pending rows use the same judgement). Query: app_id = $1 AND auth_status IN ($2, $3), served by union_accounts_app_id_id_key (app_id prefix). Host: tsc -b test apps/api 0; eslint / prettier 0; union int 54 files 696 (incl. auth-pending-count 3, admin-accounts); union unit 40 files 385.

reviews.note: Codex money review (effort medium) round 1 pass: only the app's expiring / expired accounts counted; paused, null-expiry and non-authorization probe failures handled per BR-ID-24; no isolation issue.

Container red red/1 3 red for the right reason; before review verified green on a throwaway copy with a real count. spec-test r1 pass.
